title: Parsons and Hubbard's Babylon Working

tellings.quote: The most infamous of these was the Babylon Working, an attempt to summon the divine feminine archetype known as Babylon.

plain: In 1946 in Pasadena, the rocket scientist and occultist Jack Parsons and L. Ron Hubbard, later the founder of Scientology, carried out the Babylon Working, a magical rite meant to summon the divine feminine figure known as Babylon, following ideas of the English occultist Aleister Crowley and his novel Moonchild. Jesse Michels tells it himself as the most infamous of Parsons's rituals, to show how closely early American rocketry and the occult were tied.
